summary: Verified Emergency Broadcast feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed against POST /api/admin/wall/emergency-broadcast — validates content required, 500-char cap, default author 'Fin & Feathers Management', broadcast_id linkage, per-post attributes (is_broadcast=true, is_emergency=true, user_avatar='📣', post_type='text'), and fan-out to all 8 active non-hibachi locations. Frontend: DJ Control tab renders data-testid='emergency-broadcast-card' at top with message + author inputs and broadcast button. Button correctly disabled when message empty and enabled after typing. Two-step confirm UX works: first click reveals emergency-confirm-row (cancel + confirm-send), cancel dismisses without firing POST, confirm fires POST returning 200. Success toast 'Emergency broadcast sent · Delivered to 8 locations' shown. On /social/staff-client-roles Feed tab, 8 new posts each render with data-testid='post-emergency-badge' (amber, 'EMERGENCY' label) plus location tag. Regression: 25 existing data-testid='post-broadcast-badge' entries continue rendering (red). Test data cleaned up post-run.

test_results.POST_emergency_broadcast_success: PASS — 200 with {broadcast_id, count=8, emergency:true}; posts persisted per active location with is_broadcast/is_emergency/user_avatar='📣'/post_type='text'.
test_results.empty_content_400: PASS — 400 'Message content is required' (also for whitespace-only).
test_results.default_author: PASS — omitting author_name defaults user_name to 'Fin & Feathers Management'.
test_results.fanout_count: PASS — one post per active non-hibachi location (8 hits verified via GET /api/wall/posts/{slug}).
test_results.frontend_card_visible: PASS — emergency-broadcast-card + message/author inputs + broadcast btn present at top of DJ Control tab.
test_results.btn_disabled_empty: PASS — disabled attribute present when input empty, cleared after typing.
test_results.two_step_confirm: PASS — click broadcast → confirm row appears; cancel dismisses (no POST); re-click + confirm → POST 200 fires.
test_results.success_toast: PASS — 'Emergency broadcast sent' + 'Delivered to 8 locations.' rendered.
test_results.wall_emergency_badge: PASS — post-emergency-badge visible on social wall with amber 'EMERGENCY' label + location tag.
test_results.wall_regression_broadcast_badge: PASS — 25 existing post-broadcast-badge entries continue to render.

critical_code_review_comments: DJControlTab.jsx still uses window.location.origin instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — carryover from prior iteration; recommend standardising to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

admin_emergency_broadcast in /app/backend/routes/admin.py inserts posts sequentially in a for-loop; consider asyncio.gather or insert_many for atomic + faster fan-out (minor; 8 rows so latency is trivial today).
No admin auth is actually enforced (get_current_admin is a documented no-op app-wide, per review request); this remains an app-wide P2 as noted. Not a regression.

Emergency posts share the wall_posts collection with is_emergency=true — no server-side rate-limit / cool-down; a rogue admin (or automation bug) could spam wall. Consider a simple debounce or per-hour cap.
test_credentials: admin / $outhcentral (auth is no-op app-wide; endpoint reachable without token).
seed_data_creation: Inserted transient TEST_EMERG* wall posts across 8 locations during test runs; cleaned up (32 posts deleted total across backend + frontend runs).
